author: juanpestana19
quote:

Big focus on being real life as possible, which takes the enjoyment out of it for me, if I wanted to work I would go to work.

Annoying Lucia requests and the story doesn't appeal to me as GTA V or IV

Overall I don't think it's worth the 100$ I paid or the 13 year wait
